name: Residence Visa (Employment)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be employed as a professional in a government-approved project, a Board of Investment (BOI) registered company, a bank, or Colombo Port City -- not open employment generally.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer with a BOI company, government-approved project, bank, or Colombo Port City entity.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka -- General Information on Visa: Residence Visa's Employment subcategory covers professionals in government-approved projects, BOI-registered companies, banks, and Colombo Port City

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Department of Immigration & Emigration). DISTINCTIVE STRUCTURAL FEATURE: eligibility is explicitly gated to a closed list of qualifying employer TYPES (BOI-registered companies, government-approved projects, banks, and the specially-administered Colombo Port City special economic zone) rather than any Sri Lanka-registered employer generally -- a narrower gate than most employer-sponsored work visas in this dataset. family_can_join set true per the separate Family Residence Visa subcategory (see lk_family_reunification.json); duration/fees were not specified in the source retrieved.
